# Prague Tourist Information

> > Comprehensive travel guide and ticket booking platform for Prague attractions, museums, dining experiences, and historical landmarks in the Czech Republic.

Prague Tourist Information serves as a German-language resource for tourists visiting Prague, offering ticket bookings for major attractions like Prager Burg, the Astronomische Uhr, Jüdisches Viertel, and specialized experiences at museums including the Lego Museum and Prager Biermuseum. The site also provides B2B services for tour operators and media partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Prag (Prague)
- Prager Burg (Prague Castle)
- Jüdisches Viertel (Jewish Quarter)
- Astronomische Uhr (Astronomical Clock)
- Pulverturm (Powder Tower)
- Petrin Aussichtsturm (Petrin Lookout Tower)
- Prag Pass (Prague Pass)
- Lego Museum
- Prager Biermuseum (Prague Beer Museum)
- Hard Rock Cafe Prag
- Museum Tickets
- Prague Attractions
- Family Activities
- Tourist Dining
- Tschechien (Czech Republic)

## Museum Tickets & Attractions

- [Prag Lego Museum Tickets buchen](https://praguetouristinformation.com/lego-museum-tickets): Lego Museum tickets for Prague attractions and historical landmarks
- [Tickets für das Prager Biermuseum mit Bierverkostung und Abfüllung](https://praguetouristinformation.com/tickets-fur-das-prager-biermuseum): Prague Beer Museum tickets with tasting and bottling experience

## Dining & Entertainment

- [Hard Rock Cafe Prag mit Festmenü zum Mittag- oder Abendessen](https://praguetouristinformation.com/hard-rock-cafe-prag-mit-festmenu): Hard Rock Cafe Prague dining with set menu and fast-track entry

## Business & Partnership Services

- [Reiseveranstalter, Airlines und Reisebüros - 2026](https://praguetouristinformation.com/kontakt-2/touristik): B2B contact for tour operators, airlines, and travel agencies
- [Blog, Social Media & Influencer Kooperation in Prag](https://praguetouristinformation.com/kontakt-2/influencer): Influencer and media partnership contact for Prague collaborations
